2610.13735.title: Orthros: Phase-Aware Heterogeneous Attention for Efficient Transformers
2610.13735.paper_summary: Efficient attention mechanisms, such as linear and sliding window attention, aim to reduce the computational complexity of Transformers from quadratic to linear. However, their degraded in-context recall often necessitates interleaving full attention layers, leaving the quadratic bottleneck unresolved in long-context processing. To address this, we introduce Orthros attention, which shifts the efficiency paradigm from structural allocation to phase-aware decoupling. As a unified module, it dynamically switches its computation pattern across different phases of sequence processing, enabling linear complexity prefilling and full attention decoding. Our design grants Orthros attention a lower asymptotic complexity compared to vanilla Transformers in prevalent long-context scenarios characterized by heavy prefilling and light decoding. Beyond theoretical formulation and complexity analysis, extensive empirical evaluations demonstrate Orthros's superiority across multiple dimensions. First, we validate its fundamental language modeling capabilities, demonstrating scalability across varying model sizes and strong competitiveness in comprehensive architectural comparisons. Second, Orthros exhibits exceptional conversion feasibility via a data-efficient Transformer-to-Orthros conversion, yielding performance that even surpasses the original Transformer. Finally, Orthros achieves a $21.9\times$ prefilling speedup over Transformers with end-to-end inference gains, while preserving long-context capabilities, as demonstrated by near-perfect 128K needle-in-a-haystack results and Transformer-level performance on real-world in-context recall tasks. Overall, these advantages in high performance, flexibility, and efficiency position Orthros as a promising candidate to succeed the Transformer in industrial applications.
2610.13735.paper_summary_zh: 有效的注意機制，如線性和滑動窗口注意，旨在將Transformer的計算複雜度從二次降低到線性。<lb/>然而，它們在上下文回憶中的退化往往需要交錯完整的注意層，這使得在長上下文處理中二次瓶頸無法解決。<lb/>為了解決這個問題，我們引入了Orthros注意，將效率範式從結構分配轉變為相位感知的解耦。<lb/>作為一個統一模塊，它在序列處理的不同階段動態切換計算模式，使得線性複雜度的預填充和完整注意解碼成為可能。<lb/>我們的設計使Orthros注意在普遍的長上下文場景中，相較於普通Transformer具有更低的漸進複雜度，這些場景的特徵是重預填充和輕解碼。<lb/>除了理論公式和複雜度分析之外，廣泛的實證評估證明了Orthros在多個維度上的優越性。<lb/>首先，我們驗證了其基本的語言建模能力，展示了在不同模型大小下的可擴展性，以及在全面的架構比較中強大的競爭力。<lb/>其次，Orthros通過數據高效的Transformer到Orthros的轉換，展現了卓越的轉換可行性，產生的性能甚至超過了原始Transformer。<lb/>最後，Orthros在端到端推理增益的情況下，實現了相較於Transformer的$21.9\times$預填充加速，同時保留了長上下文的能力，這一點在近乎完美的128K針對大海撈針的結果和Transformer級別的真實世界上下文回憶任務表現中得以證明。<lb/>總體而言，這些在高性能、靈活性和效率方面的優勢，使Orthros成為在工業應用中取代Transformer的有前途的候選者。
